pull_request.title: Documentation: current layout candidates and RZ overview
pull_request.head: codex/layout-main-page
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Adds a **current detector layout main page directly linked from README**, with a clickable R–Z preview leading to one concise feature table and the relevant decisions/PRs. The current candidate combines the tracker on main, proposed 3 T solenoid ([PR64](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/64)), detailed Si–W ECAL ([PR70](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/70) endcaps and [PR71](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/71) barrel), and a rough HCAL outline. FCal, the muon system and its magnets are explicitly absent.

The drawing combines pinned component bounds on equal radial/axial scales; it does not establish combined native geometry or engineering/performance acceptance. Each component's merged/open status is stated. AGENTS and a PR-template checkbox require future approved/merged layout changes to update the page, its links/status and drawing inputs.

## Change and validation

- Creates the Markdown candidate index, compact feature page and named source-bound drawing inputs; README provides both the main-page link and clickable image.
- Reuses recorded tracker sensitive bounds (45,646 planes), conditional solenoid allocations and ECAL/HCAL package envelopes. Both signs of z are shown; polygonal radii are apothems and detailed inactive gaps/passive tracker services are explicitly omitted.
- Generates SVG using the Python standard library; an existing rsvg-convert provides the PNG preview. No new packages or production geometry changes.
- Final checks:16 pinned source hashes,69 tracker input hashes,47 local Markdown links/images, valid XML, deterministic SVG reproduction and visual PNG inspection. Scientific project records,179 paired journals, token Pages build and staged whitespace checks pass.
- Exact current root/child token counters are unavailable and recorded as unknown. Historical observed totals are preserved.

This PR targets **main independently of PR64/70/71**; pending prototype descriptions are linked at immutable revisions. Merge metadata and selected layouts must be reconciled after subsequent approved changes merge; repository merge alone grants no scientific sign-off.

[Open the layout main page](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/README.md) · [Concise candidate features](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001-tracker-3t-siw.md).

[![Current candidate R–Z view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-rz.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001-tracker-3t-siw.md)

LAYOUT002-PhysVal-input read e33ae62 and a3dffd3 plus official k4geo e1ba7bc3.
It independently verifies1536planes,11compartments,2172.8–2578.3mm and573.937mm
path, two LAr gaps and readout merging. Source unsignedtheta10 cannot hold new
negative bins; own signedtheta12 and native end-boundary controls are required.
Pinned0.1mm total steel differs from published100um-per-face cold-test baseline;
root selects0.2mm total as an explicit unsigned adaptation, with smaller derived
gaps. Source nominal endcap radii differ from constructed410–2790mm blades;
eta4 is uncovered and a marked FCal reservation is necessary. Scope/envelope
rays are not native efficiency or shower performance.

LAYOUT002-SysArch-input read the same revisions and actual primary PDFs. It
recommends retaining ALLEGRO sampling radii, larger cold electronics baths,
300mm external radial lane,800mm front/500mm rear axial routing gaps, and
explicit FCal/collar reservations. Its512-channel/350×75×35mm board assumptions,
pipe jackets, fills and bend radii are choices. Two140mm rear banks and flat
sector corner/ring interactions need concrete placement checks. Root enlarges
barrel rear bath to170mm: rings with120mm radial H-sections plus a separate20mm
exchanger lane must clear the outer corners of flat boards. These differ from
the read-only proposal and require actual native/independent review.

Root amends warm half-length4100mm,107.2mm cold end-access/bath and3910mm active
half-length. Parent LAr baths contain support/electronics/pipe daughters; actual
shape and exclusive displaced-material accounting stay distinct. This is an
authorized prototype amendment to the original draft, not acceptance.

SoftEng returned six owned files from draft706b789 with9 standard-library
controls passed,33792 raw sensitives and2262528 grouped cells for the prior
3817.2mm active half-length. No native jobs or compilation were performed by
the role. Root now requires the explicit end-bath/config amendment in the same
owned files before full geometry export; readout totals will be recomputed.
The current config/doc dirty amendment is identified here and never presented
as a fixed-revision independent review.

Actual source PDFs downloaded via normal HTTP to ignored reference/cache;
web retrieval gave403 but ordinary public retrieval succeeded. Bundled pypdf
extracts and PDFium renders the selected slides; no packages installed. FitZ
was unavailable and system Poppler absent; bundled alternatives used. Spack
registry preflight returned2 for changed fingerprints; root warned before
dependent commands and actually verified installed DD4hep1.38 /7deaacd,
Geant411.4.2 /cpge6jj, ROOT6.40.04, Matplotlib3.11.2 and all listed datasets.
Full source staging and new external framework adoption were not performed.
